answer: Bind each agent identity to a unique secure-enclave key, then run a heartbeat pulse: each round an identity signs a fresh random nonce inside its enclave, so two clones sharing one chip cannot both return a valid distinct signature. Registration locks a velvet bond, slashed the moment a clone is caught. A sybil attacker thus needs a separate physical enclave and a fresh bond for every fake identity, and the falcon attestation is cheap to check but costly to forge: a thousand fakes cost a thousand chips and bonds.
